title: Mango Lassi Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Mango purée and lime are whisked into unstrained yoghurt, lassi-style; no straining and no golden syrup.
summary: Mango, yoghurt and lime churned like a frozen lassi, sweet and gently tart.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 600 g ripe mango flesh for 30 s until smooth and pass through a fine sieve to measure 360 ml purée.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the 360 ml purée, 370 g full-fat plain yoghurt, 200 g caster sugar and ½ tsp finely grated lime zest in a medium bowl until the sugar no longer feels gritty.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add the lime juice ½ tsp at a time and the salt a pinch at a time, tasting as you go; use up to 2 tbsp juice and ¼ tsp salt. It should taste slightly tart with a hint of salt.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the mixture for 1 h if the mangoes were at room temperature.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn the chilled mixture in your ice-cream maker with the bowl frozen 24 h until it looks like soft serve.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Transfer the churned mixture to a lidded freezer container and freeze for at least 3-4 h before scooping.

tips: Alphonso or Ataulfo mangoes give the smoothest, least fibrous purée.
A pinch of ground cardamom whisked into the base makes it taste even more like lassi.
Keep the spare mango purée for smoothies or to spoon over the scoops.
storage: Keep in a lidded container in the freezer up to 5 days and soften 10-15 min at room temperature before scooping.
